title: Meal Planner Direct Retailer Product & Price Reference Catalogue
importantNotes: All links are direct ASDA or ALDI product-detail pages; there are no Google or other search-result links.
The catalogue contains one row per ingredient/store pair for the 114 ingredients in the bundled recipe library.
A numeric price appears only when a price snapshot was captured from an official retailer product-page listing. Prices and product availability can vary by postcode and over time.
Rows with a direct product page but no price remain unpriced until a price is verified.
If a direct product page is not verified, its URL and price are blank rather than substituting a search-engine link.
The catalogue is restricted to ASDA and ALDI.
